summary: The owned capsule requires source patching plus recursive/dispatch harness execution and retest. This shell has GitHub Contents mutation access, Node and Git binaries, but its local runtime cannot resolve github.com and therefore cannot materialize the repository/test workspace. A patch without the mandated harness would violate done_when, so no source mutation was attempted.
unresolved: Capsule metadata required_capabilities=[] understates its actual repository_test_runtime requirement.
truth_boundary: Capability boundary only; no implementation success is asserted and no source code was mutated.
